_comment: Per-phase execution policy. 'kind' is the important field: 'code' phases are plain TypeScript in the conductor and never spawn a model — that is WHY no hook is needed to stop a model merging or deploying (docs/HOOKS.md §1). 'session' phases get one fresh Agent SDK query() that is never resumed.
_comment_cwd: 'worktree' = the leased git worktree for this ticket. 'conductor' = the Oneshot repo root, used by phases that must not see repo files at all.
_comment_writes: Filesystem scopes handed to hooks/write-scope.js via ONESHOT_WRITE_SCOPES. Anything outside is denied. 'run' expands to state/runs/<iid>/, 'artifacts' to state/runs/<iid>/artifacts/, 'memory' to state/memory/.

phases.name: testcases
phases._why: Opus, and its own phase: verify and qa must execute the SAME list or a green local run and a green demo run cover different ground and cannot be compared. It runs AFTER implement so the cases can name the real symbols and routes the change actually produced — the cost of that is a list authored with the implementation in view, so the prompt makes the acceptance criteria, not the diff, the source of truth.

phases.name: review
phases._why_group: testcases and review both consume only implement's output and neither reads the other's artifact, so they run concurrently. The one interaction — a review cycle lap re-entering implement — leaves testcases pinned (the case list is written once), so the group simply degrades to review alone on later laps.

phases.name: verify
phases._why_turns: Measured live: driving webpack + the real login form + a ~19-case list through Bash-run Playwright exhausted 90 turns before the list finished. The turn cap must fit the whole list — a verify that dies at max_turns produces no artifact, and the cycle it triggers re-pays implement and review for what was only a budget problem.

phases.name: mr
phases._why_group: ui-evidence drives the browser on the leased port while mr pushes the branch and writes the MR — disjoint tools, disjoint writes, both read-only on the diff. Running them together hides the screenshot pass inside the MR pass's wall clock.

phases.name: merge
phases._why: Code, not a session. No model holds a merge tool, so v1's label-guard approval check has nothing to guard.

phases.name: deploy
phases._why: A SESSION, deliberately — the one deterministic step this pipeline had, made adaptive on purpose. The script is still the only sanctioned path to the box (scripts/deploy-wsai.sh via scripts/deploy-watch.sh, detached, polled in slices because the Bash tool caps near 10 minutes), but a deploy that fails now gets a diagnostician: read the remote build log, check supervisor state, decide --npm/--pip from the actual diff, retry within the attempt cap. Safety moved from 'no model holds the tool' to hooks/deploy-guard.cjs — allowlisted hosts, allowlisted remote verbs, fail-CLOSED — plus a deterministic conductor check after the phase: the deployed SHA must contain this run's merge SHA and the site must answer 200, or the phase result is overruled. Retries live inside the session (schema `attempts`); onFail abort because a deploy the agent itself gave up on needs a human, not a redo.

phases.name: memorize
phases._why_order: Before document, not after — the ticket note wants to link the memory card, and the card needs nothing from the note. demo and memorize share nothing at all, so they run as a group.

phases.name: document
phases._why_turns: Measured live: this phase composes two long-form notes (the ticket and the MR) and uploads the evidence attachments behind them, on the light tier, which spends turns where a heavier model would spend tokens. 40 never fit the job — it died at max_turns with the notes half-written, and because onFail is warn that loss is silent: the run finishes green having published nothing.
